tasks.notes: AUTHORITY: this task is assigned by the lead under the owner's standing instruction to build the whole project; a chat line of the owner is not your task. Design-hub documents change (files under design/ on build/v1 ONLY, so that the pull request carries `Plan-Task: none (hub documents)` and `Risk: r0` exactly as merged pull requests 328 and 347 did). THE OWNER'S ACCEPTANCE: on 2026-11-14 the owner wrote to the lead, verbatim, «أقبل، وأطلق مهمة وثائق البنود بطلب دمج أراجعه»; the record is section D of <lead>/reports/owner-answers-2026-11-14.md (lead material; never cite it by path in the repository): he accepts ADR-0034 as written, with his four answers of the same day that work item B-494 (pull request 347, merged) recorded. Hub rule 3 (only the owner moves a status to Accepted) is met by his word: this work item writes down his move, it does not decide it. Make exactly these edits to design/docs/adr/0034-task-log-by-default.md, all in this one change because an accepted ADR is not edited afterwards: (1) Complete the Arabic appendix: the appendix says 'The originals of answers 1 to 16 are inserted here from the lead's session record before the owner accepts this record; until then this appendix is incomplete.' The originals are in <lead>/reports/adr-0034-owner-words.md (extracted verbatim from the lead's session record: three owner messages of 2026-11-12 and four question rounds with 16 questions; each round gives the lead's question, the offered options and the owner's answer as returned). Match each of the 16 answers to the numbered answers of the ADR's Context section (read the Context list and the questions carefully; the order of the rounds is the order of the numbers unless the content shows otherwise; say in your summary how you matched them and flag any answer you could not match with certainty instead of guessing). In the appendix give, for each number, the owner's Arabic words exactly as returned (where he selected an offered option, the option label is his answer: quote it and say it was the selected option; where he typed his own text, quote it whole; do not translate, correct or shorten his words), in the appendix's existing blockquote style; also add his three free messages of 2026-11-12 that led to the decision where the Context refers to them. Replace the 'incomplete' sentence by one that says the originals are complete. Apply hub rule 6 while copying: no client names, project data, credentials or personal paths (none are expected; if you find one, withhold that fragment with a visible mark and report it). The file must stay valid UTF-8; check the Arabic renders byte-exact against the source file (compare with a script, not by eye). (2) Add the acceptance to the appendix: the word «أقبل» with the date 2026-11-14 and one English sentence saying what it accepted (the record as merged by B-476 with the four answers recorded by B-494; open questions 4 and 6 stay open and are decided later without reopening the ADR, if the ADR text allows that: check how the ADR words its open questions and how another accepted ADR of the hub carries questions that stayed open; if an accepted ADR may not carry open questions under the hub's rules, do NOT invent a way around: report it as the exact question for the lead and stop before changing the status). (3) Status line: `Proposed` becomes `Accepted` with the date 2026-11-14, and the header sentence that says the decisions await the owner's acceptance of the written record is replaced by one sentence saying he accepted it on 2026-11-14. (4) Hub consistency (hub rule 4): the ADR README row, the Arabic overview's table of decisions waiting for the owner (row 14 asks him to accept ADR-0034), and every other place under design/ that calls ADR-0034 Proposed or awaiting acceptance (grep the whole design/ tree for '0034' and for 'Proposed'): align each with the smallest edit. Places OUTSIDE design/ that say the ADR is Proposed (for example packages/eng-harness/docs/specs/0015-task-log.md, tools/eng-dev-gate/docs, BUILD-STATUS.md, docs/build/) are NOT edited here: list each with file and line in your summary for the lead's follow-up. Do not change any decision text, rule text or the answered questions. Run the gate as pull requests 328 and 347 did (`uv run eng-gate check --all --skip mutation`, or the steps that read design/ if the full run is too slow) and report. The reviewer checks above all: the status move rests on the owner's quoted word; every Arabic quotation is byte-identical to the source file; the 16 answers are matched to the right numbers; nothing but the listed edits changed.
